items.headline: Public raises 30 million pounds to rewild a huge Northumberland estate
items.summary: The Wildlife Trusts secured the 3,800 hectare Rothbury estate after about 25,000 people donated, launching one of England's most ambitious nature recovery projects.
items.why_it_matters: England is one of the most nature-depleted countries in Europe, and large connected landscapes are rare.

items.headline: Appeals court refuses to set aside about 20,000 California mail ballots
items.summary: The Ninth Circuit ruled that setting the ballots aside would risk disenfranchising eligible voters, and the Supreme Court later declined to intervene, so the ruling stands.
items.why_it_matters: Courts upholding eligible voters' ballots protects the integrity of elections.
